mounting.en: The insert has rear threaded mounting points and a keyhole slot. Confirm the mechanical drawing before designing your frame. A 13.3-inch display is not ISO A4 paper size.
mounting.zh-cn: 背部提供螺纹安装点及挂孔，设计外框前应核对结构图。13.3 英寸显示区域并非 ISO A4 标准纸张尺寸。

description.en: An A2-format color e-paper display for printed-poster replacement in hotels, galleries and retail. Specify the complete unit separately from a panel-only integration.
description.zh-cn: 适合酒店、画廊与零售空间的 A2 规格彩色电子纸，用于替代低频更换的纸质海报。整机方案与裸屏集成须分别选型。
